body: Note, this extra indent is clang-format being annoying...

Figured just providing our data as it already is as a parameter, would be much more efficient than copying all the members as parameters. 

I wonder if we should insert `_blit_render_target_to_screen` into `blit_render_targets_to_screen`, there really isn't a good benefit to these being split.

Just tested this out on windows/steamvr and it threw an error here from implicitly casting `vec4` to `vec3`. Something like this fixed it! The colors do appear correct now.

```suggestion
		color.xyz = linear_to_srgb(color.xyz);
```
thats so weird, that makes 100% sense but for some reason it didn't error out for me. I wonder if there is a code path where color is a vec3 or if it was just a fluke.

GRMBL, somewhere along the line in testing I switched my hand tracking demo to the mobile renderer! So the lens distortion stuff I all properly tested, and the color fix I messed up :)

Thanks for the catch logan! I'm just going to verify my work and it should all be good :)
